contents.grouping: Exact full prompts are disjoint; templates and answer vocabulary deliberately shared
contents.split_policy: Pair offsets 1 and 4 for train, offsets 2 and 3 for val; no random split
contents.purpose: Memorization and generalization to novel combinations of known values; not an AGI benchmark or reserved holdout
